title: Cavalry to the Rescue
description: Package about Troop C 2/108th providing security and presence patrols after Hurricane Gustav.
keywords: Staff Sgt. Danny Stutzman, Spc. Bryan Lane

transcript.text: As Hurricane Gustav leaves the area, here comes a cavalry rushing to the rescue, soldiers from Troops Sea,
second of the 101st make a splash as they conduct security and presence patrols for the city of La Rose, Louisiana.
I've never been that deep into a hurricane. It was pretty wild for us to let them be reassured that they wouldn't have forgotten about.
I know if I come up to one of y'all, I mean actually what I need are if something's wrong.
Y'all are going to help me out the best y'all can.
I mean we're just very pleased that they're here. We feel very safe. We're making friends and I think that's the important thing that they're going to become part of our community.
We're just really thankful that the National Guard is here. During Hurricane Katrina we also had some national guardsmen from Tennessee here.
I enjoy being down here. I enjoy helping people. That's why I'm here.
Right now we're just trying to win hearts and minds. That's what our CO said. That's our basic mission.
Reporting Sergeant First Class Thomas Bennett.
